source: Do nguoi dung tai them thu cong vao du an (khong phai Claude tai) - MediaPipe BlazeFace short-range, model public chinh thuc cua Google (https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/blaze_face_short_range.tflite / https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/face_detector). Rieng yolov8n_logo.onnx/.pt: model TU HUAN LUYEN NOI BO boi thanh vien nhom (PyTorch + Ultralytics YOLOv8n), KHONG phai tai ve tu nguon public - xem chi tiet entry ben duoi.

models.purpose: Face DETECTION (khoanh vung mat trong anh) - dung qua cv2.dnn.readNetFromTFLite trong engine/opencv_modules.py::detect_and_crop_faces(). KHONG phai face-recognition/embedding - model nay CHI tra ve bounding box + score co mat hay khong, KHONG tra ve danh tinh. Danh tinh (suspected_name) do Agent 2 (Claude Vision) tu nhan dien truc tiep tren anh crop, KHONG dung database/embedding matching sinh trac hoc nao ca.
models.architecture: BlazeFace short-range, input 128x128 RGB normalize [-1,1], output 2 tensor (classificators, regressors) voi 896 anchor.

models.purpose: Logo REGION detection (khoanh vung 'trong nhu logo' trong anh) - dung qua cv2.dnn.readNetFromONNX trong engine/opencv_modules.py::detect_logo_regions(), duoc match_logo() goi lai de ghep voi ten brand Agent 1/Vision da doan. Day la ban ONNX xuat tu yolov8n_logo.pt de suy luan (inference) KHONG can torch/ultralytics o runtime - chi can opencv-contrib-python da co san.
models.architecture: Ultralytics YOLOv8n, exported opset 19, input 640x640 RGB normalize [0,1], output (1,5,8400) - 1 class duy nhat 'logo' (khong phan loai brand).
models.training: Tu huan luyen noi bo boi thanh vien nhom bang PyTorch (ultralytics), fine-tune threshold rieng cho bai toan phat hien logo tren thiet ke POD - CHUA duoc benchmark chinh thuc tren bo test cua he thong nay, nguong confidence (_LOGO_SCORE_THRESH=0.25) dang tam dung theo mac dinh nguoi dung tu test qua test_logo.py.

models.purpose: Checkpoint PyTorch GOC cua yolov8n_logo.onnx - giu lai de tham khao/huan luyen tiep, KHONG duoc code nao trong engine/ load truc tiep (runtime chi dung ban .onnx qua cv2.dnn, tranh phu thuoc torch/ultralytics).
models.training: Cung nguon voi yolov8n_logo.onnx (xem entry tren) - day la checkpoint truoc khi export ONNX.
